title: KFC Boxfull Range $5/$10/$15 - Daily until 2pm (App Only) @ KFC
body:
Deal: KFC Boxfull Range $5/$10/$15 - Daily until 2pm (App Only) @ KFC

[TheDukeOfNukem] What in the AI bullshit is this?
That picture is a load of bollocks, like that's actual false advertising. We've got a million of these since they came out due to the sliders being so expensive on their own. The fiver one is a slider, a tender, chips, and like a sauce or something. That picture shows way more than you actually get.
[freewhere] We need Japanese Ad guidelines where product must match the box and the ad.
[NotReallyaMoneySaver] This cannot be a real ad from KFC can it? They already made a poster, showcasing the food. Also there's no price for the $10 box
[Tyrx] It's real. Even their official videos advertising the deal are in a similar style and obviously AI generated. I guess this is the future.
[mwblink86] Its not
This is the proper promo pic
https://www.frugalfeeds.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/KF…
[SarcasticEmu] Then where the hell did this picture come from? You can tell the picture OP posted is fake since it's advertising no swaps as a feature.
[Adammw] Wasn't there a version of this ad showing the $5 box having nuggets, despite not being included in the box?
[BenDoverson] meh its not that good of a promo - by kfc standards…
[Jollystacker] could tell it was AI from the thumbnail lol
[g110gbg] https://files.ozbargain.com.au/upload/446709/130264/photo-ou…
[SarcasticEmu] What? You've never seen a floating burger before?
[hutcho] Old news, and get this AI crap outta here.
[kingofthenorth] Noone's posted it because it's not good value.
[FujinShu] So does this mean the $4.95 fill up is now forever gone nationwide?
[Jollystacker] it just pops up every now and then in varying forms
[Pistnbroke] This is not a deal, all you have done is advertised KFC’s overpriced lard on a bargain website
